about.title: A Coffee Legacy from Toba Land
about.subtitle: PT. Siholta Toba Indonesia was born from a love of coffee and the fertile land of North Sumatra. We are committed to producing premium quality coffee.
about.heading: Bringing Lintong Coffee Excellence to the World
about.body: Lintong coffee has established itself as one of the finest specialty coffees from Sumatra. Grown in the highlands of Lintong Nihuta, this coffee offers unique characteristics combining spicy aroma, herbal notes, and captivating nutty and chocolate undertones.

products.title: Premium Quality Selection
products.subtitle: From whole beans to ground, and gift hampers, we offer a variety of choices for your needs.
products.wholesale: Need bulk quantities for your business?

export.title: Kopi Siholta Conquers World Markets
export.subtitle: Trusted by importers and distributors across multiple countries.
export.target_body: In our 2026 growth roadmap, Kopi Siholta has identified China and Australia as strategic new markets.

partnership.title: Let's Collaborate
partnership.subtitle: Open to various forms of partnership — from coffee supply to franchise coffee shops.

tourism.title: Experience the Grandeur of Lake Toba Firsthand
tourism.subtitle: Visit our coffee plantation in Lintong Nihuta and enjoy a unique experience of brewing coffee while gazing at the stunning views of Lake Toba.

contact.title: Interested in Contributing?
contact.subtitle: Don't hesitate to reach out. The Kopi Siholta team is ready to help you find the perfect coffee solution.
